name: Jack Bullion
role: Horseman with a ranch on Bullion creek
bio: Jack Bullion brought about thirty horses in for the round-up in June 1884 and in 1885 had a ranch on Bullion creek, where his brother Robert from Minnesota joined him with horses. At the end of November 1885 sixteen of his ponies were sold at about twenty dollars each.
